name: 1 Timothy
author: The apostle Paul. Some scholars question Pauline authorship of the pastoral letters, though the church has long affirmed it.
date: Usually dated in the early 60s AD.
setting: Written to Timothy, who is leading the church in Ephesus.
theme: Guard sound teaching and organize the church for godly life.

outline.label: Instructions for Timothy and the church
A good servant of Christ Jesus
Contentment, wealth, and a final charge

christInBook: Paul says that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners (1:15), that there is one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus (2:5), and that the church is the pillar and buttress of the truth (3:15).
howToRead: 1 Timothy is a letter from an older pastor to a younger pastor. Notice how Paul returns to sound teaching, godly character, and the dangers of false teaching and love of money.
